svg.aria-label: Calculated Fe oxidation-state predominance, pH versus Eh

g.text: Calculated validation prototype · 2,565 exact samples · public support pending
Total Fe = 10⁻³ mol/kg H₂O · 25 °C · 1 bar (declared) · ideal · fixed pH / Eh

path.title: Water reference — H₂ · unit normalized fugacity, water activity 1; gas equilibrium not solved
Water reference — O₂ · unit normalized fugacity, water activity 1; gas equilibrium not solved

g.text: Color indicates oxidation-state predominance, not physical appearance.
Dots: no majority · diagonal hatch: tie · crosshatch: unavailable (none in this grid).
Dashed: water H₂ / O₂ references · unit normalized fugacity, a(H₂O) = 1 · gas equilibrium not solved.
Cell footprints represent sampled points, not exact boundaries. Eh limits are a validation range.
Equilibrium classification does not predict formation times, corrosion rates or kinetic persistence.
